text:
From: dock-b@hartwell-dock.example
Sent: Tue 25 Aug 2026 14:12
Subject: RCVD - Northwind PO-48201

Hi team, FedEx Freight dropped the Northwind order at door 4 this morning (25 Aug). Counted against the BOL:
FST-BOLT-M8 x 2,400 ea, FST-NUT-M8 x 2,400 ea, FST-WSH-M8 x 5,000 ea. Pallet wrap intact, nothing crushed.
Signed clean. -- Dana (Dock B)

From: dock-a@hartwell-dock.example
Sent: Wed 26 Aug 2026 09:40
Subject: Delta Packaging delivery / P.O. 48202

UPS Freight showed up at 8:15 with Delta's cartons and tape. PO ref on the slip says P.O. 48202.
PKG-CTN-L: 12 cases (50 per case per the packing list). PKG-TAPE-48: 144 rolls loose in 4 shrink-wrapped trays.
Everything looks fine. Received 08/26/2026.

From: dock-b@hartwell-dock.example
Sent: Sun 30 Aug 2026 16:55
Subject: Helix oil+grease, short on grease

XPO truck, Helix Lubricants, PO-48203. Oil: LUB-OIL-5L - 20 cases (4 per case). Grease: LUB-GRS-400 - only 8 cases
of 24 on the pallet, the BOL says 10 cases were loaded but we counted 8. I wrote it up on the exception sheet.
Dock log date 30 Aug.

From: dock-a@hartwell-dock.example
Sent: Tue 1 Sep 2026 11:03
Subject: Corvid electrical - one crushed pallet corner

Old Dominion delivered Corvid (PO-48204) today, 1 September. ELC-CBL-3M: 20 boxes of 25, fine. ELC-SW-16A: 12 boxes of 10 and two
of the boxes were crushed on one corner with a switch housing cracked inside. Photos are in the claim folder. Keep the whole line
quarantined until QA looks.

From: dock-c@hartwell-dock.example
Sent: Thu 3 Sep 2026 15:20
Subject: Unmarked Brightline drop - no paperwork

Brightline Safety driver left a delivery at door 2 without a delivery note and nobody here has a PO number for it - the driver
just said 'it's the gloves and hats'. Carrier was DHL Freight. We counted 1,200 pairs of SAF-GLV-L and 150 SAF-HAT-Y hard hats, boxes
intact. Procurement needs to find which order this belongs to. Received 3 Sep.

From: dock-c@hartwell-dock.example
Sent: Wed 2 Sep 2026 10:10
Subject: Brightline PO-48205 received

PO-48205 arrived via Estes today (2 Sep). SAF-GLV-L: 10 cases (the case label says 120 pairs each). SAF-HAT-Y: 150 hard hats
in 15 cartons of 10. All good, no issues. Please close the receipt.

From: dock-a@hartwell-dock.example
Sent: Mon 31 Aug 2026 13:31
Subject: Pallets in - Orchard

Orchard Pallets, PO-48206, delivered by their own truck (carrier: Orchard Direct). 30 bundles of PLT-STD-48 at 10 pallets per bundle.
Counted each bundle. Condition fine, a few are a bit dusty but structurally fine. 31 Aug.

From: dock-b@hartwell-dock.example
Sent: Sat 5 Sep 2026 08:48
Subject: Northwind PO-48207 - extra anchors on the truck

FedEx Freight, Northwind Fasteners, PO-48207, received 5 September. FST-BOLT-M10: 1,800 each as ordered. FST-ANCH-12: we got 400 each -
the PO was for 360, so 40 more than ordered. Did not refuse it, put the extra in the overflow cage. Someone needs to decide
whether we keep or return them.

From: dock-a@hartwell-dock.example
Sent: Tue 8 Sep 2026 12:02
Subject: Helix PO 48208 in

Drum delivery from Helix (PO 48208), carrier UPS Freight, today 8 Sep. LUB-OIL-20L: 24 drums, all upright and sealed.
LUB-FLT-HX: 8 cases of 12 filters. Nothing wrong that I can see.

From: dock-c@hartwell-dock.example
Sent: Wed 9 Sep 2026 17:14
Subject: Delta Packaging PO-48209 - labels short

XPO dropped Delta's order, PO-48209, Wed 9 Sep. PKG-FILM-18: 10 cases of 6 rolls, good. PKG-LBL-4X6: 18 rolls of labels, each roll
is 1,000 labels, but we ordered 20,000 labels so we are two rolls short. Delta says the balance ships next week.

From: dock-b@hartwell-dock.example
Sent: Sat 12 Sep 2026 07:30
Subject: Corvid delivery (yesterday)

Writing this up from Friday's shift notes - Corvid Electrical delivery for PO-48210 came in yesterday via Old Dominion.
ELC-FUSE-10A: 20 boxes of 100. ELC-CBL-3M: 10 boxes of 25. Both looked fine on the dock; seals intact.

From: dock-c@hartwell-dock.example
Sent: Sun 6 Sep 2026 10:45
Subject: Northwind anchors+bolts, FedEx

Northwind Fasteners PO-48207 second delivery (they split the shipment). FedEx Freight, 6 Sep. FST-BOLT-M10 - 1,800 ea. FST-ANCH-12 -
we counted 500 ea which is well above the 360 on the PO. I have not flagged it anywhere yet.

From: dock-a@hartwell-dock.example
Sent: Thu 27 Aug 2026 09:15
Subject: Delta cartons PO-48202 (2nd truck)

Second Delta Packaging truck for PO-48202, Estes, 27 Aug. PKG-CTN-L - 600 each, PKG-TAPE-48 - 4 cases of 36 rolls.
Matches the order, no damage.

From: dock-b@hartwell-dock.example
Sent: Fri 4 Sep 2026 14:50
Subject: Brightline PO-48205 gloves short

Brightline PO-48205 via DHL Freight, 4 Sep. Gloves SAF-GLV-L: 5 cases of 120 pairs = 600 pairs, a lot less than the 1,200 on the PO.
Hard hats SAF-HAT-Y: 150, correct. Supplier rep says a second pallet is on the way.

From: dock-a@hartwell-dock.example
Sent: Mon 7 Sep 2026 09:05
Subject: Northwind PO-48207 received (boxed)

Northwind PO-48207, FedEx Freight, Mon 7 Sep. Everything came boxed: FST-ANCH-12 18 boxes (20 per box) and FST-BOLT-M10 36 boxes
(50 per box). Matches the order, no damage, good to put away.

From: dock-c@hartwell-dock.example
Sent: Thu 10 Sep 2026 13:20
Subject: Helix PO-48203 - leaking cartridges

Helix PO-48203, Thu 10 Sep, carrier Old Dominion. LUB-GRS-400: 240 cartridges as ordered. LUB-OIL-5L: 80 cans but one case (4 cans) is
leaking through the carton and the pallet is slick. Count is right, condition is not. Needs a claim.

From: dock-b@hartwell-dock.example
Sent: Fri 11 Sep 2026 10:30
Subject: Corvid cables PO-48204 re-ship

Corvid Electrical re-shipment under PO-48204, UPS Freight, Fri 11 Sep. ELC-CBL-3M: 20 boxes of 25 (500 cables). Packing slip matches. Fine.

From: dock-a@hartwell-dock.example
Sent: Wed 9 Sep 2026 16:05
Subject: Pickup from Orchard - no PO, ref only

We collected pallets ourselves from Orchard Pallets' yard (our own trailer, so carrier: Hartwell fleet). They gave us pickup ref A-7731 but no purchase
order number. 120 x PLT-STD-48, stacked 10 high, all good. Please have purchasing match it to a PO. Date: 9 Sep.

From: dock-c@hartwell-dock.example
Sent: Thu 10 Sep 2026 11:48
Subject: Delta delivery - invoice INV-48210 attached

Delta Packaging, UPS, 10 Sep. Their paperwork says P.O.# 48209 (and the invoice they attached is INV-48210, ignore that, it's theirs).
PKG-FILM-18: 60 rolls, PKG-LBL-4X6: 20 rolls of 1,000 labels. Both lines complete, boxes dry and intact.

From: dock-b@hartwell-dock.example
Sent: Sat 12 Sep 2026 09:25
Subject: Corvid PO-48210 - fuses short a couple of boxes

Corvid PO-48210, XPO, Sat 12 Sep. ELC-FUSE-10A: 18 boxes of 100 (the PO was 2,000 so 200 short, they have not said why). ELC-CBL-3M: 10 boxes of 25.
Cables fine. Raise the shortage with Corvid.
